name: MegaUSD
oneLiner: USDM is MegaETH's dollar stablecoin issued on Ethena's USDtb rails, backed ~90% by BlackRock BUIDL tokenized Treasuries; reserve yield funds sequencer costs.
collateral: ~90% USDtb (BlackRock BUIDL tokenized Treasuries via Securitize) with liquid stablecoins for redemptions
pegMechanism: Issued on Ethena's USDtb rails; reserve yield funds MegaETH sequencer costs

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: MegaETH documents USDm as a native stablecoin and its mainnet bridge guide lists Stargate/LayerZero support for bridging USDm to MegaETH. The route is reviewed as external lock/mint/OFT-style bridge exposure.

genius.notes: Issuer is MegaUSD (BVI) Ltd, incorporated in the British Virgin Islands (confirmed via Terms of Service and Mint User Agreement at app.megausd.money). U.S. users are explicitly excluded from USDm Mint services. The coin's marketing references USDtb's 'line of sight to GENIUS Act compliance' via Anchorage Digital Bank, but this applies to USDtb (the underlying asset), not to MegaUSD (BVI) Ltd itself. No US bank charter, money-transmission license, PPSI application, or foreign-exception filing was found. GENIUS Act rulemaking remains at proposed-rules stage; no PPSI approvals exist anywhere as of 2026-06-18.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: MegaUSD (BVI) Ltd is incorporated in the British Virgin Islands; US users are explicitly excluded from Mint services. No US PPSI application, state qualification, OCC conditional approval, or foreign-exception filing was found for MegaUSD or its BVI issuer entity. The USDtb 'GENIUS line of sight' claim belongs to Anchorage Digital Bank (USDtb issuer), not to MegaUSD (BVI) Ltd.

mintAuthority.summary: USDM is MegaETH's dollar issued on Ethena's USDtb rails and backed ~90% by USDtb; its supply tracks USDtb-backed issuance, so it inherits USDtb's Ethena-operated mint authority rather than running an independent mint path. The wrapper's own admin is a 9-owner 4/9 Gnosis Safe; no direct mint function or proxy upgrade admin exists on either deployment.

controls.label: USDM logic owner (Gnosis Safe 9/4)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294742: owner() on both MegaETH (block 18390248) and Ethereum USDM proxies returns 0x141C03AbC062a9d5d4238e1666B849C929e53cB2. On-chain getOwners() returned 9 addresses; threshold() = 4 (confirmed slot 4); getModules() returned empty array (no modules); guard slot 0x33 = zero; fallbackHandler = zero; masterCopy (slot 0) = 0x41675c099f32341bf84bfc5382af534df5c7461a (GnosisSafe 1.3.0, ContractName Safe on Blockscout). This owner is a logic-level admin only; proxy upgrade admin slots are 0x0 on both chains (upgradeability not set/renounced).

review.evidence: Wrapper verification complete. Both USDM deployments (MegaETH 0xFAfD..., Ethereum 0xec2a...) are ERC1967Proxy contracts with impl xUSDOFTUpgradeable (LayerZero OFT), no proxy upgrade admin (admin slot = 0x0), no direct mint function, no MINTER_ROLE. Owner (same on both chains) is Gnosis Safe 0x141C03... with 9 owners, threshold 4, no modules, confirmed at Ethereum block 25294742 and MegaETH block 18390248. Parent coin usdtb-ethena tracked separately.
